name: Mabl
tagline: Mabl is a low-code test automation platform for web and mobile applications that uses AI to keep tests working as UI changes. QA engineers and developers use it to record browser-based tests without writing selectors manually, with auto-healing that updates tests when page elements change rather than failing on every UI update. It integrates with CI/CD pipelines so tests run automatically on each deployment.
